title: Teeny junky products and a coupon
text: Cheap, tiny, junk. I was billed for January and February, was sent 2 really cruddy January Boxes with the same ugly lipstick and granny blush. The sad little sponge... this Box was worth maybe 2 dollars, not including the stupid coupon for nail stickers you need to create an account and upload pictures in order to cash in. What a waste TWICE! THIS IS BY FAR THE WORST MONTHLY BOX OUT THERE. I  have had Play, I currently get ipsy, birchbox and boxycharm. They are all cheaper and 500x better. Fuel to the fire was the double January Box, at least if it was skin care products I could use them for travel, but when will I ever use 2 full size lipsticks ( in the same color)in our era of public mask requirements.  They aren't even good lipsticks. The color is ugly and it's super drying. I asked why the double shipment, they said I had 2 accounts, which I do not.  They refused to return my money, or even send the proper Box to replace their mistake. 46$ for 2 muave lipsticks, 2 muave blushes, 2 teeny sponges, and 2 coupons I have no intention of going through the effort of redeeming. Literally... one of their items is a friggin coupon. Get real guys.
label: negative
